headline: Samsung Electronics is 24.9% of the Korean stock market
facts: Samsung Electronics is 24.9% of Korea's entire stock market (KOSPI + KOSDAQ) by market cap.
The two largest — Samsung Electronics and SK hynix — are 44.8% of the market between them.
The top 10 stocks are 57.3% of total market value; the top 57 are about 80%.
KOSPI holds 92.5% of market value across 943 issues; KOSDAQ 7.5% across 1821.
source: Korea Exchange OPEN API (KOSPI + KOSDAQ daily), market cap by issue
caveat: Ratios only — scale-invariant, independent of the price level. Latest trading day.
